scope: Pre-run connector source reads only; no workflow outputs

structuredContent.content:
name: Desktop playability P1
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/desktop-playability-p1]
    paths: ["game/**", "scripts/**", ".github/workflows/desktop-alpha.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      lane:
        description: Native qualification hosts
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: all
        options: [all, arm-macos-ios, windows, linux]
      observe_windows_input:
        description: Retain bounded guest-loopback Windows input stage observations
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
jobs:
  native:
    if: github.event.repository.private == false
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 3
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.lane == 'linux' && '[{"os":"ubuntu-24.04","target":"linux"}]' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.lane == 'windows' && '[{"os":"windows-latest","target":"windows"}]' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.lane == 'arm-macos-ios' && '[{"os":"macos-15","target":"macos"}]' || '[{"os":"ubuntu-24.04","target":"linux"},{"os":"windows-latest","target":"windows"},{"os":"macos-15","target":"macos"},{"os":"macos-15-intel","target":"macos"}]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      SIGHTBREAK_BUILDS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/builds/desktop-playability
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Linux display dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgl1 libvulkan1 libxtst6 xvfb tesseract-ocr
      - name: Windows OCR dependency
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          choco install tesseract --version=5.5.0.20241111 --yes --no-progress
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          $ocr = 'C:/Program Files/Tesseract-OCR/tesseract.exe'
          if (!(Test-Path $ocr)) { throw 'Tesseract executable missing' }
          "TESSERACT_BIN=$ocr" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
          & $ocr --version
      - name: Native screenshot dependency
        run: python -m pip install Pillow==12.3.0
      - name: Install checksum-pinned native editor and selected templates
        run: python scripts/toolchain.py setup --targets ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Packaging integrity controls
        run: python scripts/test_build_manifest.py -v
      - name: Strict native log failure controls
        run: python scripts/test_native_log.py -v
      - name: Atomic observation reader filesystem semantics
        run: python scripts/test_native_observation.py -v
      - name: Verify strict native menu captions
        run: python scripts/test_offline_export_ocr.py -v
      - name: QA receipt packaging controls
        run: python scripts/test_package_qa_receipts.py -v
      - name: Export exact clean source
        id: export
        run: python scripts/export.py ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Inspect development package structure independently of gameplay qualification
        id: package_inspection
        run: python scripts/verify_builds.py --targets ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Native graphical startup and artifact inspection (Windows/macOS)
        if: runner.os != 'Linux'
        run: python scripts/verify_builds.py --targets ${{ matrix.target }} --graphical
      - name: Retain macOS OpenGL diagnostic after default virtual-GPU failure
        if: failure() && runner.os == 'macOS'
        shell: python
        run: |
          import os, pathlib, sys, subprocess, json
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
          from build_manifest import BUILDS, OUTPUTS, validate_record
          from native_log import failed
          record = validate_record('macos')
          out = BUILDS / 'verification'
          capture = out / 'macos-opengl-diagnostic.png'
          command = [str(BUILDS / OUTPUTS['macos']), '--rendering-driver', 'opengl3', '--audio-driver', 'Dummy', '--', '--smoke', '--capture='+str(capture)]
          with (out / 'macos-opengl-diagnostic.log').open('w') as log:
              result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=120)
          output = (out / 'macos-opengl-diagnostic.log').read_text(errors='replace')
          report = {'default_driver_failure_retained': True, 'source_commit': record['source_commit'], 'command': command, 'exit': result.returncode, 'clean_log': not failed(output), 'capture_exists': capture.is_file(), 'scope': 'Diagnostic explicit OpenGL override on hosted virtual GPU; not default-launch acceptance'}
          (out / 'macos-opengl-diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
          print(output[-16000:])
          print(json.dumps(report))
          if result.returncode or failed(output) or not capture.is_file(): raise SystemExit(1)
      - name: Native graphical startup and artifact inspection (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: xvfb-run -a python scripts/verify_builds.py --targets linux --graphical
      - name: Native authority and compatibility regressions
        id: native_regressions
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success'
        run: python scripts/run_native_regressions.py --output builds/desktop-playability/regressions
      - name: ARM Mac first failed leak suite diagnostic controls
        id: macos_leak_diagnostic_controls
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15' && steps.native_regressions.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          python scripts/test_diagnose_native_input_mode.py -v
          python scripts/test_native_first_leak.py -v
      - name: ARM Mac retain verbose first failed leak suite after strict failure
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15' && steps.native_regressions.outcome == 'failure' && steps.macos_leak_diagnostic_controls.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 6
        run: python scripts/diagnose_native_input_mode.py --failed-output builds/desktop-playability/regressions --output builds/desktop-playability/source-leak-verbose
      - name: ARM Mac read-only input preflight observer controls
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        run: python scripts/test_probe_macos_input.py -v
      - name: ARM Mac permission queries and ordinary exported-window preflight
        id: macos_input_preflight
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        run: python scripts/probe_macos_input.py --output builds/desktop-playability/macos-input-preflight
      - name: ARM Mac native menu input source controls
        id: macos_menu_controls
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        run: |
          python scripts/test_macos_menu.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_focus.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_screen_identity.py -v
      - name: ARM Mac real exported Settings pointer and Escape navigation
        id: macos_menu_input
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15' && steps.macos_input_preflight.outcome == 'success' && steps.macos_menu_controls.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: python scripts/verify_macos_menu.py --preflight builds/desktop-playability/macos-input-preflight/results.json --output builds/desktop-playability/macos-menu-input
      - name: ARM Mac ordinary exported gameplay source controls
        id: macos_ordinary_controls
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        run: |
          python scripts/test_macos_ordinary.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_ordinary_controller.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_ordinary_paths.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_ordinary_startup.py -v
          python scripts/test_macos_deploy_ocr.py -v
      - name: ARM Mac stock Deploy living sidearm and ordinary leave
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15' && steps.macos_input_preflight.outcome == 'success' && steps.macos_menu_input.outcome == 'success' && steps.macos_ordinary_controls.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 6
        run: python scripts/verify_macos_ordinary.py --preflight builds/desktop-playability/macos-input-preflight/results.json --output builds/desktop-playability/macos-ordinary-input
      - name: Real exported keyboard and pointer input (Windows/Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/verify_integration_export.py --target ${{ matrix.target }} --visit-armory --timeout 240 --output builds/desktop-playability/native-input ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && inputs.observe_windows_input && '--observe-input-consumption' || '' }}
      - name: Controlled delayed-capture reload comparison (Windows)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: python scripts/verify_integration_export.py --target windows --input-schedule release-first --fire-capture-delay 4 --timeout 240 --output builds/desktop-playability/reload-release-first
      - name: Retain original delayed-capture schedule (Windows diagnostic)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: python
        run: |
          import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          output = pathlib.Path('builds/desktop-playability/reload-legacy-delayed')
          command = [sys.executable, 'scripts/verify_integration_export.py', '--target', 'windows', '--input-schedule', 'legacy', '--fire-capture-delay', '4', '--timeout', '240', '--output', str(output)]
          result = subprocess.run(command, timeout=270)
          receipt = {'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'scope': 'Controlled diagnostic: delays capture while original schedule still holds fire. Does not replace the normal undelayed gameplay gate.'}
          (output / 'diagnostic-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
          print(json.dumps(receipt))
      - name: Living-player offline input and settings restart (Windows/Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/verify_offline_export.py --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '--hosted-render-priority below-normal' || '' }} --display :102 --timeout 300 --output builds/desktop-playability/offline-input
      - name: Real player plant and natural device resolution (Windows/Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/verify_offline_match.py --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '--hosted-render-priority below-normal' || '' }} --scenario plant --display :103 --timeout 180 --output builds/desktop-playability/offline-plant
      - name: Real player defuse after ordinary bot plant (Windows/Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/verify_offline_match.py --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '--hosted-render-priority below-normal' || '' }} --scenario defuse --display :104 --timeout 180 --output builds/desktop-playability/offline-defuse
      - name: Complete stock-rules offline match and earned training restart (Windows/Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os != 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/verify_offline_match.py --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '--hosted-render-priority below-normal' || '' }} --scenario full-match --display :105 --timeout 1800 --output builds/desktop-playability/offline-full-match
      - name: Rendered desktop layouts and explicit touch selection (Linux)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: python scripts/capture_desktop_layouts.py --touch-toggle --output builds/desktop-playability/layouts
      - name: Download immutable macOS alpha comparison artifact
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'macOS'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh api repos/calebaiken/sightbreak/actions/artifacts/12247215871/zip > "$RUNNER_TEMP/sightbreak-macos-frozen.zip"
      - name: Native macOS minimal/frozen/candidate graphical diagnosis
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: python scripts/diagnose_macos_startup.py --output builds/desktop-playability/macos-diagnostics --baseline-archive "$RUNNER_TEMP/sightbreak-macos-frozen.zip"
      - name: Intel macOS render feature attribution after the unchanged startup gate
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15-intel'
        run: python scripts/diagnose_macos_render.py --output builds/desktop-playability/macos-diagnostics/render-features
      - name: iOS compile qualification controls (ARM macOS)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        run: python scripts/test_qualify_ios_compile.py -v
      - name: Unsigned generic-device iOS compiler and linker qualification (ARM macOS)
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && matrix.os == 'macos-15'
        timeout-minutes: 17
        run: python scripts/qualify_ios_compile.py --output builds/desktop-playability/ios-compile --builds builds/ios-device-export --derived-data builds/ios-device-derived --timeout 900
      - name: Preserve source-bound development package including failed qualification attempts
        if: always() && steps.export.outcome == 'success' && steps.package_inspection.outcome == 'success'
        run: python scripts/build_manifest.py package --targets ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Preserve development packages and failed attempts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-playability-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/desktop-playability/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Package bounded raw QA receipts
        if: always()
        run: python scripts/package_qa_receipts.py --source builds/desktop-playability --output builds/qa-receipts/qa-receipts.zip
      - name: Preserve separately downloadable raw QA receipts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-qa-receipts-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/qa-receipts/qa-receipts.zip
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve separately downloadable QA evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-qa-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            builds/desktop-playability/**/*.json
            builds/desktop-playability/**/*.jsonl
            builds/desktop-playability/**/*.log
            builds/desktop-playability/macos-diagnostics/*.txt
            builds/desktop-playability/**/*.png
            !builds/desktop-playability/offline-full-match/round-*.png
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Package bounded original Linux layout PNGs by native size
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: python
        run: |
          import json, pathlib, sys
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
          from package_qa_receipts import package
          failures = []
          for size in ('960x540', '1280x720', '1920x1080', '1280x800'):
              source = pathlib.Path('builds/desktop-playability/layouts') / size
              if not source.is_dir() or not any(source.glob('*.png')):
                  print('No original layout PNGs for ' + size)
                  continue
              try:
                  print(json.dumps(package(source, pathlib.Path('builds/layout-images') / (size + '.zip'), layout_pngs=True)))
              except Exception as error:
                  failures.append(size + ': ' + str(error))
          if failures:
              raise SystemExit('\n'.join(failures))
      - name: Preserve original Linux layout PNGs at 960x540
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-layout-images-960x540-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/layout-images/960x540.zip
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve original Linux layout PNGs at 1280x720
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-layout-images-1280x720-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/layout-images/1280x720.zip
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve original Linux layout PNGs at 1920x1080
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-layout-images-1920x1080-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/layout-images/1920x1080.zip
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve original Linux layout PNGs at 1280x800
        if: always() && runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sightbreak-layout-images-1280x800-${{ github.sha }}
          path: builds/layout-images/1280x800.zip
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
